programme.title: It
programme.desc: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.

programme.title: The Rock
programme.desc: A scientist (Nicolas Cage) and a British spy (Sean Connery) who once escaped from Alcatraz are sent to the former island prison to stop a disgruntled war hero (Ed Harris) from obliterating San Francisco with chemical warheads.

programme.title: Mid90s
programme.desc: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.

programme.title: Stoker
programme.desc: After the tragic death of a girl's father, an eccentric uncle comes to live with the teen (Mia Wasikowska) and her unstable mother (Nicole Kidman). Though she suspects the man has ulterior motives, she becomes increasingly infatuated with him.

programme.title: Bring Her Back
programme.desc: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

programme.title: Oracle
programme.desc: A young woman accepts a job on a property with a traumatic past. Upon her arrival, she soon realizes that the nightmares of her childhood are connected to the evil in the house.

programme.title: The Belko Experiment
programme.desc: Trapped inside their office building, 80 employees (John Gallagher Jr., Tony Goldwyn, Adria Arjona) at a Colombian corporation must play a sadistic game of survival that requires them to kill a certain number of co-workers.

programme.title: Pawn
programme.desc: A robbery turns into a tense hostage situation when three gunmen hold up a diner the mob uses as a front.

programme.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
programme.desc: A depressed teenager (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a psychiatric facility and winds up in the adult ward, where a fellow patient (Zach Galifianakis) takes him under his wing.

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island that's a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
programme.desc: Placed under federal protection in Madea's Southern home, a Wall Street banker and his dysfunctional family get a taste of the no-nonsense matriarch's special brand of tough love.

programme.title: Hidden Figures
programme.desc: NASA mathematicians Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson cross gender and race lines to help launch astronaut John Glenn into outer space.

programme.desc: Four best friends travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush.

programme.title: Friendship
programme.desc: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor.

programme.desc: Voyage inédit en France d'avant la France ; comment le pays s'est-il constitué et quelles furent ses frontières, parfois minuscules, parfois étendues, associées à de grands noms : Vercingétorix, Clovis, Charlemagne, Philippe Auguste, Jeanne d'Arc.

programme.title: J'ai survécu à un tueur en série
programme.desc: En 1975, Tony Antonucci, 15 ans, est engagé par l'entrepreneur John Wayne Gacy ; deux mois plus tard, lorsqu'il le reçoit chez lui, il est loin de se douter que son nouveau patron est un tueur en série et que son heure est sur le point de sonner.

programme.title: Onze victimes

programme.desc: A Mexican outlaw/folk hero (Ricardo Montalban) and his men agree to bring a land baron's wife to 1840s San Francisco.

programme.desc: An electronics mogul (John Ritter) coerces a former commander (Olivier Gruner) into helping him find the terrorist who killed his wife.
